actions.old_quote: All Xero access tokens expire after 30 minutes. Refresh tokens allow your app to obtain new access tokens without involving a user again.
actions.new_quote: No, we've implemented short-lived tokens with long-lived authorizations as is best practice for OAuth 2.0. All Xero access tokens expire after 30 minutes. Refresh tokens allow your app to obtain new access tokens without involving a user again. Alternatively, if you'd prefer not to have to manage a refresh token, you might be interested in the premium, Custom Connection option. It utilises the client credentials grant type and only requires your client id and client secret to request new access tokens.
actions.review_note: The strict checker falsely treated overflow-x-hidden as hidden. This full visible paragraph preserves 30-minute access tokens, refresh-token purpose, and the separately scoped Custom Connection alternative.

actions.old_quote: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days. If you don’t refresh your access token within 60 days the user will need to reauthorise your app.
actions.new_quote: What is the expiration for a refresh token? Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days. If, for whatever reason, you don't receive the response you can retry refreshing your existing refresh token for a grace period of 30 minutes.

actions.old_quote:
Sentry's [MCP server](https://mcp.sentry.dev) connects your AI assistant to Sentry over the Model Context Protocol. Follow the setup and authentication instructions there for your client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and others).

Connect using one of these endpoints:

* `https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp`: base endpoint
* `https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug}`: scoped to one organization
* `https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug}/{projectSlug}`: scoped to one project (recommended)

The first connection starts an OAuth flow to link your Sentry account.
actions.new_quote: Sentry's MCP server connects your AI assistant to Sentry over the Model Context Protocol. Follow the setup and authentication instructions there for your client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and others). The Sentry MCP has been optimized to retrieve Snapshot results for agentic workflows. If you'd like, you can also fetch the data via the REST API and expose scripts to agents. Connect using one of these endpoints: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp : base endpoint https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug} : scoped to one organization https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug}/{projectSlug} : scoped to one project (recommended) The first connection starts an OAuth flow to link your Sentry account.
actions.review_note: The current Markdown page adds intervening Snapshot/REST text. The replacement uses the contiguous rendered HTML passage and preserves Sentry-operated MCP directionality, base/organization/project endpoints, and first-connection OAuth.
